ValidationRule.description: Requires verified candidate data before an application is submitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Candidate__c)), NOT(Candidate__r.Is_Resume_Verified__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The candidate resume must be verified before the application is submitted.
